cache_contract.cached: the static radius-four exact-cover formula, full next-ring availability/conflict formula, and every accumulated pair-coverability constraint
cache_contract.rebuilt_each_solve: the selected triple orbit, encoded quadruple constraints when enabled, and all forbidden-state clauses
cache_contract.validation: cache metadata binds every structural encoding option and the complete canonical pair-key set; a missing cached pair or changed configuration rebuilds the cache
cache_contract.seed_behavior: the serialized assertions are loaded into a newly configured solver, so each CEGAR iteration can retain its requested random seed
cache_contract.scope: formula reuse only; Z3's learned clauses and search state are not persisted

two_iteration_cegar_profile.result: The actual CEGAR driver changes seeds and reuses all 771 pair constraints. Construction falls by 93.7% and total wall time by 92.0% under matched one-second checks.

interpretation: Validated formula reuse removes almost all repeated construction cost without changing the exact constraints or suppressing solver-seed diversity. The one-second checks intentionally time out, so this profile makes no tiling claim. It makes longer ranked CEGAR portfolios materially cheaper; solver search itself remains the dominant cost under production time limits.
